page_note: 整页只有一张图：ACEA报告第11页的「Figure 3. Top 10 global car producers」2023/2024分组柱状图，柱上方带灰底同比变化率气泡标注，下方为S&P Global Mobility来源行。

components.evidence: two bars, dark navy 2023 and cyan 2024, sit side by side in each country slot
swatches '2023' and '2024' sit between the title line and the plot area
grey rounded boxes '+5.2%', '-6.2%', '-18.2%' with pointer tails drawn over the plot above each pair
country names 'China', 'EUROPEAN UNION' are set vertically, turned 90 degrees under the axis
faint horizontal rules at each million tick; no vertical rules in the panel
'SOURCE: S&P GLOBAL MOBILITY' in small print under the plot
the only printed numbers, the percentage boxes, sit above the bar tops, not on the bars

new_components.name: derived_change_callout_per_group
new_components.evidence: boxed '+5.2%' … '-12.2%' above each 2023/2024 pair gives year-on-year change, not either bar's value
new_components.why_it_matters: 图上唯一印出的数字是派生的同比百分比，10个柱组的绝对产量必须全部靠像素对刻度估读；解析表若只抓这些百分比会与真值（如26,704,000）完全不匹配。

new_components.name: aggregate_category_in_capitals
new_components.evidence: 'EUROPEAN UNION' set in full capitals among title-case names like 'United States'
new_components.why_it_matters: 全大写提示该类目是国家集合体而非单国，定位某一条柱时必须逐字照抄'EUROPEAN UNION'作为行名，否则与成员国数据混淆。

spot_checks.mark: the China 2024 cyan bar (tallest bar, just above 26.5m)
the South Korea 2024 cyan bar (the pair is nearly equal, -1.2% box)

difficulty_notes: 刻度间距为5,000,000，在图上约占90像素，即1像素≈55,000。对China的26,704,000而言5%容差约1.34M（24像素），尚可估读；但Indonesia的931,000容差仅46,550，约不到1个像素，Brazil的1,899,000容差95,000也只有约2像素，Canada/Indonesia两组柱高不足20像素，根本无法在5%内读出。图上唯一印出的数字是灰框里的百分比变化，解析器抓到的是'+5.2%'一类派生值而非产量本身，所以第2步（取值）最致命；第3步只需'China'+'2024'两个键即可定位，相对容易。
